derivation.boundary: Every one of the 34 Endpoint declarations and all 36 Schema declarations in Pinhere's product-owned v1 PontxSpec; no Endpoint is omitted.
derivation.method: byte-for-byte source preservation; PontxSpec is the canonical provider contract

riskReview.readRisk: Read responses can contain private project resources, issue text, DOM context, screenshots, Token metadata, and Webhook delivery diagnostics.
riskReview.mutationRisk: POST, PATCH, and DELETE Endpoint calls can create, change, delete, claim, complete, reopen, rotate, revoke, or send Pinhere resources and external Webhook deliveries.
riskReview.credentialPolicy: PATs, website session cookies, OAuth authorization codes, OAuth tokens, refresh tokens, and code verifiers remain in the caller-owned local environment. Hub cannot receive, store, log, proxy, or execute them.
riskReview.executionPolicy: The local CLI previews every call, redacts sensitive values, and requires a request-bound confirmation token before any non-dry-run call. Production Hub renders disabled execution for every Pinhere Endpoint.

releaseBlockedBy: Canonical pinhere.dev DNS and discovery bytes have not yet been verified.
